name: Slow Cooker Beef Cheeks in Red Wine Sauce
ingredients_verbatim: 1.5 kg/3lb beef cheeks (4 large or 6 small beef cheeks)
1 onion (white, brown or yellow), roughly diced (about 1 cup)
6 stems of fresh thyme or 1 1/2 tsp dried thyme leaves
4 dried bay leaves (or 3 fresh bay leaves)
2 cups (500 ml) red wine (full bodied eg. cabernet sauvignon or merlot)
why: Squarely mid-band (586 cal, 49 g protein, only 6 g carbs) and structurally low-carb: beef + wine + aromatics with NO starch base (source nutrition already excludes the mashed potato serving suggestion). A rich braise cut the catalog has no version of (no beef-cheek dish exists), and it deliberately carries an unmapped signature ingredient (beef-cheeks has no board home; chuck-roast is the natural fallback) to prove the pricer lane. Verified nutrition read directly from the source recipe card.
